# Closing a pane where a coding agent works, or waits on you, says so by
# its name (Rex's "Did you mean to close"), not just "a program is running".
# The reports are Claude Code's own (OSC 7501, app claude-code).
type:printf '\033]7501;state=working:app=claude-code\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
wait:1.5
action:close_surface
wait:0.6
expect-sheet:yes
expect-sheet-text:Claude Code is still working.
sheet:Cancel
wait:0.4
key:ctrl+c
type:printf '\033]7501;state=blocked:app=claude-code\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
wait:1.5
action:close_surface
wait:0.6
expect-sheet-text:Claude Code is waiting for your answer.
sheet:Cancel
wait:0.4
# Any other program: as before.
key:ctrl+c
type:printf '\033]7501;state=clear:app=claude-code\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
wait:1.5
action:close_surface
wait:0.6
expect-sheet-text:A program is still running and will be ended.
sheet:Cancel
